title: Large Deviations for Random High-Dimensional Projections
statement:
Let $\Theta^{(N)}$ be uniform on $S^{N-1}$ and set $\nu_N=\mu_{\Theta^{(N)}}$. Does $(\nu_N)$ satisfy a large-deviation principle with speed $N$ and rate function

$$I(\nu)=-\frac12\log(1-\|\alpha\|_2^2)$$

when $\nu=\kappa_\alpha$ for some $\alpha$ in the open unit ball of $\ell_2$, and $I(\nu)=\infty$ otherwise? As an intermediate step, are the possible Prohorov limits of

$$E_N=\left\{\operatorname{law}\!\left(\sum_{i=1}^N\alpha_iU_i\right):\alpha\in S^{N-1}\right\}$$

exactly $\{\kappa_\alpha:\alpha\in\ell_2,\ \|\alpha\|_2\leq1\}$?
